title: Experience the Best of Miami Shopping
abstract: Miami is a shopper's paradise, offering everything from high-end designer boutiques to local artisan markets. Explore the best shopping destinations that reflect the city’s unique style and flair.

packages.title: Luxury Shopping Tour
packages.description: Get a VIP shopping experience at Miami’s top luxury destinations, including a personal stylist and exclusive access to designer boutiques.

packages.title: Artisan Market Shopping Tour
packages.description: Discover unique, handmade goods from local artisans with a guided tour through Miami’s best outdoor markets and craft fairs.

packages.title: Vintage Treasure Hunt
packages.description: Explore Miami’s best vintage and thrift shops, guided by a local expert who will help you uncover rare finds and hidden gems.

packages.title: Design District Fashion Experience
packages.description: Take a guided tour of Miami’s famous Design District, visiting luxury fashion boutiques, art galleries, and designer showrooms.

packages.title: Lincoln Road Mall Shopping Spree
packages.description: Enjoy a day of shopping at Miami’s iconic Lincoln Road Mall, with stops at popular stores, cafés, and entertainment spots.

packages.title: Miami Fashion Week Experience
packages.description: Get a behind-the-scenes look at Miami Fashion Week, with exclusive access to shows, designers, and a chance to meet top industry professionals.
